title: Index a List with Map
prompt:
Write `indexById(users)` that returns a Map from each user's `id` to the user object, and `lookup(index, id)` that returns the user or `null` when absent.

Then write `groupByRole(users)` returning a Map from role to an array of users with that role.

tests.name: index maps id to user; lookup misses return null
tests.hint: new Map(users.map((u) => [u.id, u])) builds it in one expression.

tests.name: groupByRole buckets users
tests.hint: reduce into a Map: get the bucket with ?? [], push, set back.
